Class SkullEyes

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.SkullEyes
public final class SkullEyes extends Object
The live eyes of one placed mob head: a GooglyTracker.EyeInfo pupil per configured eye, stepped with the same physics as mob eyes for a head that never moves, plus the expression playing on them. Only the eyes of parts are stepped and drawn.

A head has no triggers of its own, so it plays only ambient expressions, and every client derives them from what all clients share: the head's position and the level's game time. Time is cut into slots of the server's mean ambient interval; a random source seeded from the position and the slot picks the slot's expression and its start, so every player sees the same expression at about the same tick with nothing sent. A tracker created mid-expression joins it where it already is. The ongoing mob states (squints, lids, anger, pulse, rattle) don't apply.
